parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` — `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveArtist` in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` (package: Metadata) and `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveRelease` in `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift` (package: app:iOS). These are test-local mock method implementations whose structural similarity (Jaccard 0.714) reflects the shared mock-object pattern rather than a production abstraction opportunity. Lifting them into a shared generic function would couple two independent test packages through a shared test utility, which is undesirable. The methods also resolve distinct domain entities (`Artist` vs `Release`), so the similarity is partly coincidental at the name level.
